headline.zh: 新加坡咖啡文化先驱品牌

traits.zh: 供应比安卡松露披萨、松露雪花芝士薯条、朗姆葡萄芝士蛋糕
traits.en: Serves Bianca truffle pizza, truffle snow cheese fries, and rum grape cheesecake

traits.zh: 设有开放式吧台及大理石桌面配黑色椅子的顾客区
traits.en: Open bar counter and customer area with marble-top tables and black chairs

traits.zh: 店内有绿植装饰，天花板为白色条板并配有吊扇
traits.en: Indoor greenery and white slat ceiling with ceiling fans

traits.zh: 创立超20年，为新加坡咖啡文化先驱与高端品牌代表之一
traits.en: Founded over 20 years ago as a pioneer of Singapore coffee culture and premium brand

linger.zh: 绿植环绕+露台营造城中度假氛围
linger.en: Greenery and terrace evoke urban resort vibe

energy.zh: 露台位置营造城中度假氛围
